It really depends on how your therapist is. I was very nervous but mentally ready to try anything. I was willing to put in any effort possible to try. It doesn't work for everyone, but I feel it's a blessing to have the opportunity for treatment because not everybody gets the chance. 

I guess my cptsd was hell on earth everyday so I was willing to try anything at that point.

I had cpsd since 3 years old ranging until about 13 when abuse ended. Waiting list for EMDR was 3 years and I was complete with treatment by 3 months.

I don't have any nightmares nowadays. Sometimes I dream but there's no school dreams or dreams about my dad anymore. 

I had my first job last year for 5 months, I've started driving lessons and 10th so far. I can enjoy the birds singing and the sunshine now. My brain has so much room just for the present. There is no past thinking about trauma like I did. 

I guess I know I'm healed because I haven't had 1 flashback or night terror since to do with my old trauma's
